title: Annotatio II §.VII: Under remaining substances — BODY AND BLOOD; sense proves bread/wine, faith the rest
pass_a_gloss: But with the substances of bread and wine remaining, at the utterance of those words BODY AND BLOOD OF CHRIST, they truly begin to be UNDER THOSE (namely under the substances of bread and wine) so that under the same Accidents BOTH are truly received — BREAD AND FLESH, WINE AND BLOOD — of which the one sense proves, the rest faith believes.
pass_b_english: With bread and wine substances still there, at Body and Blood of Christ those start to be under them.
Under the same accidents both are truly received — bread and flesh, wine and blood — sense proves one, faith the other.
source_text: Sed panis & vini substantiis permanentibus ad prolationem illorum verborum CORPUS ET SANGUIS CHRISTI, veraciter incipiant esse SUB ILLIS (nempe sub panis & vini substantiis) ita quòd sub eisdem Accidentibus UTRUMQUE verè suscipitur PANIS ET CARO, VINUM ET SANGUIS, quorum alterum probat sensus, reliquum credit fides.
